extract_wikipedia_text: run the WikiExtractor to extract and clean text from a Wikipedia XML dump file into output files
load_templates_from_file: load template definitions from a preprocessed template file for use during extraction
parse_wiki_pages: scan a Wikipedia XML dump and yield individual page data including id, title, namespace, and text
filter_wiki_pages: filter Wikipedia pages by namespace, disambiguation markup, and category include/exclude lists
expand_wiki_templates: expand MediaWiki templates and parser functions in wikitext using the Extractor class
